polymarket_market_data.primary_source: Polymarket Gamma API and CLOB API
polymarket_market_data.canonical_timestamp_rule: Retain UTC retrieval time separately from market start/end/resolution timestamps and CLOB price-point timestamps.
polymarket_market_data.revision_pinning_rule: When persisted in an authorized private sink, pin each normalized snapshot by deterministic SHA-256 and retain market/condition/token identities without rewriting prior observations.
polymarket_market_data.retry_policy: Fail closed on network, schema, identity, token/outcome cardinality, or price-range errors; a failed run must not replace prior valid observations.
polymarket_market_data.rate_limit_policy: Use the documented public Gamma/CLOB endpoints at the scheduled hourly cadence; do not split requests to evade provider limits.
polymarket_market_data.public_repository_policy: Public Git history, workflow logs, caches, and artifacts must not contain raw, derived, aggregated, or anonymized Polymarket observations. Public workflows may expose only PASS/FAIL source-health state.
